Laura / Soojin — quick legal note on sequencing.

We typically see three pragmatic paths:
1) Parallel track (fastest): Order Form signed early to enable procurement to reserve committed capacity; MSA + DPA negotiated concurrently. We insert a conditional clause: pilot terms apply until MSA/DPA finalized.
2) Sequential conservative: MSA (commercial/legal backbone) signed first, then Order Form, then DPA finalization. This decreases risk but adds 2–3 weeks.
3) Hybrid (recommended here): Order Form + limited pilot SOW signed with a short-term DPA addendum to cover PHI-sensitive data; final DPA redlines rolled into MSA amendment post-pilot.

Key inputs from MediWell we need now: any required CLINs for SOC 2 scope, whether you'll ingest PHI during pilot, and a point-of-contact for IL/PR legal redlines. If PHI is in scope, we should route to our Compliance team ASAP (adds 3–5 business days for evidence package).

I'll prepare a redline-ready MSA + our standard DPA and share within 24 hours once we have your POC.

—Karthik
